scientific_integrity: A direct algebraic proof establishes the claimed class and counting formulas. Finite-field enumeration supports but cannot replace the proof. Related prior Jordan results are explicitly credited. An independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic, nondegenerate symmetric spin factors with quadratic-space dimension at least 4, and only nonzero rank-one weight-zero Rota–Baxter maps. Only the reduced rank-one variety is characterized; no higher-rank, characteristic-two, or conjugacy-orbit classification, and publication priority is provisional.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter spectra of finite-field spin factors and discriminant recovery
